sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:11

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:11:1
items.html: the Ruach [spirit] which he casts into her: Meaning, in the vessel that raises the MAN, mentioned above in the adjacent item, there is also discerned the discernment of the light that is clothed in the vessel; and this light is called by the name of the Ruach [spirit] that he casts into her. And likewise by the name “that Ruach that her husband leaves in her at the first intercourse,” as he writes further along.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:11:2
items.html: And before this discernment of the Nefesh enters her, she is deficient and unfit to bear: For as long as her posterior — which is the AHP of her ten Sefirot — has not returned to the degree of the Nukva of Atzilut, she lacks the NHY of the vessels and the GAR [first three] of the lights, as above. Therefore she is unfit to bear, until she has the Nefesh in its completeness — that is, after the first coupling of her Gadlut, when her AHP return to her and the Nefesh is completed in her in the NHY of the vessels and the GAR of the lights. And remember here that AHP and NHY are one measure.
